subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be resolved by documenting the existing pi-tui newline behavior only, or should OpenClaw add a TUI send/newline keybinding preference surface?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed newline insertion, but the configurable behavior requested in the discussion would create a new user-facing TUI config or CLI contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Existing TUI Keys First
options.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while leaving Enter-to-send as the only OpenClaw-owned TUI behavior.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility and upgrade tests.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat pi-tui's built-in newline behavior plus the separate WebChat shortcut work as enough, and explicitly decline TUI configurability and docs/help follow-up.

recommendation.title: Document Existing TUI Keys First
recommendation.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback while leaving Enter-to-send as the only OpenClaw-owned TUI behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history owner for the TUI docs/help/editor surface and the adjacent WebChat shortcut merge.
